## Parent

https://github.com/Piyushmanyata/snp-camps/issues/41

## What to build

The same screens, rendering measurably faster on a ₹6–10k Android, with every expensive visual effect gone and every legibility affordance intact.

This is a subtraction ticket. It should be almost entirely deletions.

## Decisions already made — do not re-decide these

**Delete these, everywhere they appear:**

1. **`backdrop-filter` and `-webkit-backdrop-filter`.** Both occurrences in `src/app/globals.css` (currently `blur(18px) saturate(1.4)` and `blur(14px) saturate(1.4)`). Backdrop blur forces the GPU to composite everything behind the element every frame; on the device floor it is the single most expensive thing on screen. The sticky navigation is the worst offender because it is always visible. **No exceptions — the nav loses it too.**
2. **All gradient backgrounds.** `bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-soft to-card` and every sibling. Replace with a solid `--brand-soft` or `--card` fill.
3. **Multi-layer box-shadows.** `--shadow`, `--shadow-card`, `--shadow-lift` are three-tier layered shadows. Delete the tokens and every use. Elevation is expressed by a **1px `--border` outline and spacing** instead.
4. **The toast entry animation** and its `@keyframes toast-in`. The toast appears; it does not slide.
5. **`next/font/google` and Plus Jakarta Sans.** Remove the import from `src/app/layout.tsx`, the dependency on the font, and the `--font-plus-jakarta-sans` variable.

**Keep these exactly as they are — they are not decoration:**

6. The high-contrast light palette, including `--muted: #475569` chosen for outdoor glare.
7. `--touch-min: 3rem` (48px), `--text-body: 1.0625rem` (17px), `--text-small`, `--text-caption`.
8. Focus rings (`--ring`, `--ring-offset`) and all `prefers-reduced-motion` handling.
9. Border radius. It costs nothing to render and its removal buys nothing.

**Font replacement:**

10. Use a system stack: `system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif`. Zero bytes downloaded, zero layout shift, first paint is immediate.
11. **Preserve tabular figures** for registration numbers, queue counts and timestamps with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Every system font supports this. Registration numbers misaligning in a list is a real usability loss and is not acceptable collateral.
12. Re-check contrast after the font change — a different typeface at the same size can read lighter. The palette does not change, but if any text now fails against its background, fix the weight, not the colour.

**Scope boundary:**

13. **This ticket restyles nothing.** It removes effects. No layout changes, no spacing changes, no component restructuring, no colour changes. If a screen looks plainer afterwards, that is the intended outcome.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No `backdrop-filter` or `-webkit-backdrop-filter` anywhere in the codebase
- [ ] No gradient background utilities or CSS gradients remain
- [ ] The three shadow tokens and all their uses are gone; surfaces are distinguished by a 1px border
- [ ] The toast animation and its keyframes are deleted
- [ ] `next/font/google` is no longer imported; the font package is removed from `package.json`
- [ ] Registration numbers and counts still align in columns (tabular figures verified visually and noted in the closing comment)
- [ ] Touch targets remain ≥48px and body text ≥17px — state how this was verified
- [ ] CSS bundle size before and after is recorded in the closing comment (baseline: 64,704 bytes raw)
- [ ] Route budgets are lowered to the new measured sizes and committed
- [ ] No screen's layout or spacing changed

## Blocked by

- #42 — the budget gate must exist first so this ticket's win is measured rather than asserted.

## Skills to use

`ponytail` (mandatory — this is a deletion ticket, delete more than you think), `check-work` before closing.

## Closing evidence required

Per `README.md`: literal `npm run verify` output, literal `npm run test:e2e` output or a named environment blocker, and a statement of what coverage was removed. Plus the before/after CSS and per-route JS table.

## Closed — #43 Strip expensive visual effects and web font

**Commit:** `1e566df` on `main`

### What changed
- Removed all `backdrop-filter` / `-webkit-backdrop-filter` / `backdrop-blur-*` (nav dock, toast, modals, desk header)
- Replaced gradient backgrounds with solid `bg-brand-soft` / solid card / solid page background
- Deleted `--shadow`, `--shadow-card`, `--shadow-lift` tokens and every elevation shadow (Tailwind + custom). Surfaces use 1px borders
- Deleted toast entry animation + `@keyframes toast-in` (toast appears in place)
- Removed `next/font/google` Plus Jakarta Sans; system stack: `system-ui, -apple-system, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, sans-serif`
- Kept `.tabular` / `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` for reg numbers and counts
- Kept touch min 48px (`--touch-min: 3rem`) and body 17px (`--text-body`)
- Lowered route budgets: `/doctor` 524000→523000, `/volunteer` 526000→525000

### CSS size (raw)
| | Bytes |
|---|---:|
| Ticket baseline | 64,704 |
| Before this change (post-#45 build) | 63,122 |
| After | **53,736** |

Delta vs ticket baseline: **−10,968 raw** (−17%). Gzipped CSS ~10,195.

### JS route budgets (gzipped) after
| Route | Actual | Budget |
|---|---:|---:|
| / | 265794 | 274000 |
| /admin | 508116 | 524000 |
| /doctor | 507705 | 523000 |
| /register | 398645 | 411000 |
| /volunteer | 509645 | 525000 |
| (others) | within | lowered where measured |

### Tabular figures
`.tabular` utility still sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on reg numbers (patient form success, QR card, Stats). System fonts support tabular nums — verified class still present on those surfaces.

### Touch / body size
Verified in `globals.css`: `--touch-min: 3rem` (48px), `--text-body: 1.0625rem` (17px). No layout/spacing edits in this ticket.

### `npm run verify`
```
lint: pass
tests: 105 (95 pass, 10 skipped DB), 0 fail
build: Next.js 16.2.11 OK
check:js-budget: all routes within limits
```

### `npm run test:e2e`
```
13 passed (1.5m)
```

### Coverage removed
None — pure style deletion; no tests deleted.

### Layout note
No intentional layout or spacing changes. Screens look plainer by design.

title: Strip the expensive visual effects and the web font
